verdict: Sir. Ahmed came prepared to troubleshoot HDMI connections in Yeezy Foam Runners, proving that tech support waits for no fashion trend.
detailedQuote: While the plain black tee and washed jeans scream 'I pulled an all-nighter grading assignments,' the foam clogs say 'I trade crypto during student presentations.' It's a surprisingly daring mix of minimalist tech-bro chic and classroom technical difficulties.
